definitions.gloss: every other month; every two months; bimonthly
definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two months, with one month skipped in between. The kanji {隔|かく} means 'to separate' or 'at intervals.'

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔月|かくげつ}⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧だ。
{隔月|かくげつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We hold meetings every other month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔月|かくげつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ことにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make a point of getting health checkups every other month.

notes:
The prefix {隔|かく} means 'at intervals of' and is used in several time-related compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔月|かくげつ}⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ — bimonthly publication
- {隔月|かくげつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — every other month
- {隔月|かくげつ}{刊|かん} — bimonthly journal

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{隔週|かくしゅう}→隔週：15282_kakushuu⟧ — every other week
- ⟦{隔年|かくねん}→隔年：19987_kakunen⟧ — every other year
- ⟦{隔日|かくじつ}→隔日：16891_kakujitsu⟧ — every other day
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧ — every month (without skipping)

USAGE:
Used mainly in formal or organizational contexts — schedules, publications, and regular events. In casual conversation, ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧ (once every two months) is more natural.
